resources.description: 托管设置，覆盖顺序 1（最高）。文档：托管设置高于其他一切层级。系统目录：macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/，Linux/WSL /etc/claude-code/，Windows C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\。本快照只读该文件，不读 managed-settings.d/ 与 managed-mcp.json。
项目本地设置，覆盖顺序 3（命令行 --settings 位于 1 与 3 之间，本快照不读取命令行参数）。文档：仅本人、仅本项目。
项目共享设置，覆盖顺序 4。文档：对该文件夹内所有人生效，可提交到版本控制。
用户设置，覆盖顺序 5（最低）。文档：对本机所有项目生效。
仅元数据：文档称该文件保存登录会话、MCP 服务器配置与项目信任决定。本快照只探测存在性，不读取内容，也不修改。

flags.description: Minimal mode: skip auto-discovery of hooks, skills, custom commands, subagents, plugins, MCP servers, auto memory and CLAUDE.md. Sets CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE.
Skip permission prompts. Equivalent to --permission-mode bypassPermissions.
Add bypassPermissions to the Shift+Tab mode cycle without starting in it.
Start in restricted mode: removes command-running built-in tools, confines file tools to working directories, loads only managed settings and --settings, and refuses bypassPermissions.
Start with all customizations disabled (CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers and others) to troubleshoot a broken configuration.
Print response without interactive mode (-p).
Load the most recent conversation in the current directory (-c).
Disable session persistence so sessions are not saved to disk and cannot be resumed. Print mode only.
When resuming, create a new session ID instead of reusing the original (use with --resume or --continue).
Enable verbose logging with full turn-by-turn output.
Automatically connect to IDE on startup if exactly one valid IDE is available.
Disable all skills and commands for this session.
Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config, ignoring all other MCP configurations.
Set a display name for the session (-n).
Set the model for the session with an alias such as sonnet, opus, haiku or fable, or a full model name. Overrides the model setting and ANTHROPIC_MODEL.
Set the effort level for the session. Available levels depend on the model. ultracode requires Claude Code v2.1.203 or later.
Begin in a specified permission mode. bypassPermissions skips permission checks. The manual alias requires Claude Code v2.1.200 or later.
Output format for print mode.
Input format for print mode.
Limit the number of agentic turns. Print mode only.
Stop the run once estimated spend on API calls reaches this amount. Print mode only. Budget enforcement behaviors require Claude Code v2.1.217 or later.
Specify an agent for the current session (overrides the agent setting).
Fallback model or comma-separated list of models tried in order when the primary model is overloaded or unavailable.
Enable the server-side advisor tool with a model alias (fable, opus, sonnet) or a full model ID. fable requires Fable access.
Tools that execute without prompting for permission (alias --allowed-tools). Grants execution without a permission prompt.
Deny rules (alias --disallowed-tools). A bare tool name removes the matching tools from Claude's context.
Restrict which built-in tools Claude can use: a list of tool names, or default.
Comma-separated list of setting sources to load: user, project, local.
Set how agent team teammates display.
Set the auto-compact window for this session, using the values accepted by /autocompact (for example 500k).

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: API key sent as X-Api-Key. Used instead of a Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise subscription even when logged in.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Value of the Authorization header; prefixed with Bearer.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY
env.description: Workspace API key for Claude Platform on AWS. Takes precedence over AWS SigV4.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY
env.description: Microsoft Foundry API key.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for Microsoft Foundry. Takes precedence over ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY.

env.name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
env.description: Bedrock API key.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Passphrase for an encrypted mTLS client private key.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
env.description: OAuth access token for claude.ai authentication. Takes precedence over keychain-stored credentials.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: OAuth refresh token for claude.ai authentication. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES
env.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes for the refresh token. Required when the refresh token is set.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS
env.description: Custom request headers as Name: Value, newline-separated. May carry credentials, so it is treated as secret.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
env.description: Override of the API endpoint, for a proxy or gateway. Remote Control is disabled when it points at a host other than api.anthropic.com (v2.1.196 or later).

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS
env.description: Refresh interval in milliseconds for the credential produced by apiKeyHelper.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WINDOWS_SHELL_LAUNCHER
env.description: Start PowerShell directly instead of through cmd.exe.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT
env.description: Turns off the time limit on critical-path removal prompts. In bypassPermissions mode the prompt waits for an answer.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SUBSTITUTION_RM_PROMPT
env.description: Turns off the substitution-output rm check. The other critical-path checks keep running.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_INLINE_SHELL_RM_PROMPT
env.description: Stops reading shell -c scripts for critical-path removals. Shell variable and positional parameter targets are still checked.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUNTED_DRIVE_RM_PROMPT
env.description: Turns off the mounted drive prompt. Ignored in a settings env block.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POWERSHELL_CMD_RM_DENY
env.description: Turns off the PowerShell check that denies cmd removal built-ins. Ignored in a settings file env block.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTH_REFRESH_LOCK
env.description: Runs the refresh command without waiting on other processes. The process runs the gcpAuthRefresh and awsAuthRefresh commands itself.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY
env.description: Path to the mTLS client private key file. The page does not state a value type, so the value is display only.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER
env.description: Launches Claude Code's spawned processes through an argv-prefix launcher. Set in the env block of user or managed settings. The value form is not stated, so display only.
env.configAlternative: env block of user or managed settings

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH
env.description: Path to Git Bash on Windows; the path becomes the shell that runs commands. The page does not state a value type, so display only.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS
env.description: Plugin directories to load for the session; relative paths are skipped. Plugins can contain executable code. The list format is not stated, so display only.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR
env.description: Read-only plugin seed directories; pre-cached plugins are used without re-cloning. Plugins can contain executable code. The list format is not stated, so display only.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH
env.description: Reload mods when their files change. The page gives an enum-or-boolean form, so display only.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY
env.description: Respect the machine execution policy instead of the default -ExecutionPolicy Bypass. Group Policy MachinePolicy and UserPolicy are never overridden. The value type is not stated, so display only.

env.name: BETA_TRACING_ENDPOINT
env.description: OTLP/HTTP endpoint for beta tracing; detailed traces are sent to it. Ignored in project and local settings.

env.name: CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE
env.description: Forces claude --cloud to upload the local repository.
